latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

Big change (maybe breaking in your old environment) is moving away from PyQt5 to PyQt6. This will help with installation issues for M1 and M2 based systems.

* Update GUI to PyQt6 (Fix for M1 and M2 OS X) by @JoepdeJong in https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR/pull/236
* feat: add utf-8 support for reading README file by @llxlr in https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR/pull/201

## New Contributors
* @llxlr made their first contribution in https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR/pull/201
* @JoepdeJong made their first contribution in https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR/pull/236

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR/compare/0.0.29...0.0.31
